# GitHub Copilot

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in the repository root: it holds the project's rules, commands and layout.

To change a built presentation file (`Presentation.html` in the root) (texts, slides, notes, timings, theme, animations) without its editor, use the skill in
[.claude/skills/animated-presentation/SKILL.md](../.claude/skills/animated-presentation/SKILL.md). Copilot finds skills in
`.claude/skills/` by itself (agent mode, Copilot CLI, cloud agent).
